description: This shell script performs verification of package signatures using various methods including OpenSSL, KMS, and custom certificate validation. It handles input validation, signature verification, certificate validation, and logging, primarily for software package integrity checks in an RDK-based environment.

methods.name: debug_log_msg
methods.description: Logs debug information about files, including their MD5, SHA256, and size metrics.

methods.name: validateCert
methods.description: Validates an SSL certificate against the RDK CA chain using OpenSSL.
